text: Stepping into this hallway, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The glass wall reveals a vividly designed exhibit space with the prominent 'R + D'—research and development. As I enter, the vibrant colors and interactive displays suggest a celebration of human ingenuity. The environment feels both futuristic and hopeful, inviting me to ponder how our ideas and innovations ripple out into the world. I am eager to learn and reflect.
